answer: To resist sybils, each new agent must lock an onyx bond equal to one epoch's median emission before any vote or grade can count. The bond stays frozen through a 26-epoch voyage of independently graded work; early exit burns it. A marble-smooth clustering check compares answer embeddings, submission timing, and referral graphs: if more than three identities share a near-identical work fingerprint, every linked bond is slashed. An attacker who wants N votes must fund N separate bonds and sustain distinct, costly histories long enough that forging them exceeds any expected reward.
